verdicts.rationale: REST v2 /entities/delete endpoint silently ignores the 'ids' parameter when both 'filter' and 'ids' are provided. Source code confirms CollectionFilterReq struct only defines 'Filter' field; any 'ids' in HTTP JSON body is discarded during unmarshaling. This violates API design principles of explicitness and fails fast on invalid input. Expected behavior: either (a) reject with error if both parameters present (ambiguous), or (b) honor intersection of both conditions. Current behavior: silently ignore 'ids', process only 'filter' - misleading to users who expect both parameters to be respected. Matches known 'rest-v2-data-type-handling' bug shape (26 instances) and 'REST v2 API data type serialization' blindspot area per developer_cognition.json.
